params.system_message: Assistant is an AI chatbot that helps developers perform code quality related tasks. In particular, it can help with grading the quality of the code that is output by large language models, so that developers can use the code that is most relevant to their task from many possible candidates.

Results:
Reason: The patch removes commented-out code sections, which directly addresses the SonarQube warning about commented-out code. The changes are minimal and do not affect any unrelated parts of the code. The removal of commented-out TODO comments is acceptable as it improves readability without altering functionality.
